display_name: The whole Notaries Public Act 1959 (ss 1-8): appointment and temporary appointment, when an appointment has effect, oath powers under s 4, revocation, the s 7 offence, rules — from 1 June 2007
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 05 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition): ss 1-8. Inert: the long title and s 1. Every rule about a day refuses for a day before 1 June 2007, when Act 20 of 2007 last amended the Act; earlier texts were not supplied. NOT encoded: the powers of notaries public in England (s 4(1)) and the Notaries Public Rules under s 8 (s 4(3)(c)); where an answer turns on them, a named REFUSE.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-05 (tests-independent.l4, expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); its findings and their triage are in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 3(5): 'a period exceeding one month' by the calendar month.
forks.F2: s 3(1), (6): an appointment of n months runs to the day before the same date n months on, and never past 12.
forks.F3: s 2: a revocation under s 6 ends the appointment as one under s 5 does.
